conditions: SAJ's B2 datasheet names B2-5.0 to B2-25.0 as one to five BU2-5.0 modules with one BC2-HV1 control module, and the B2 manual (V1.2, PDF p5) says the B2 can only be used as such a set: the control module is an article of its own.

SAJ's Configuration Instructions V1.0 (Section 2) give the H2 series system as H2 + BC2 + BU2. SAJ's B2 datasheet names B2-5.0 to B2-25.0 as one to five BU2-5.0 modules with one BC2-HV1 control module, and SAJ's B2 manual (V1.2, PDF p5) says the B2 can only be used as a set with SAJ's H2 high voltage series storage inverter. The listing does not cover the one-module B2-5.0, whose operating voltage lies below the H2 T3's battery voltage range.

One BU2-5.0 module alone operates at 89.6 to 115.2 V (SAJ's B2 datasheet gives this for the one-module B2-5.0), below the H2 T3's battery voltage range of 180 to 800 V; two modules operate at 179.2 to 230.4 V.

sections.title: Assumptions and limits
paragraphs: This report contains no economics: no payback period, cash flow or feed-in tariff.
The string layout uses Trina Solar TSM-460NEG9R.28 as a reference module; the module you install can change it.
Self-sufficiency figures describe an average household; measured values differ with each household's habits.
Open-circuit voltage checked at −10 °C cell temperature. (Planning assumption without a published source)
MPP voltage checked at 70 °C cell temperature, with the module's Voc temperature coefficient. (Planning assumption without a published source)
DC cable: 15 m per string and pole until the route is measured. (Planning assumption without a published source)
Two connector pairs per string: one at the array, one at the inverter. (Planning assumption without a published source)
